packageRules.description: Patch, minor, digest and pin updates merge themselves once the branch is green and up to date with main, after the 3-day minimumReleaseAge, as in the sibling repos. Majors stay PRs. platformAutomerge is off: main has no branch protection and the repository does not allow auto-merge, so Renovate merges a green, up-to-date branch itself, with a merge commit like every other PR here. A merge to main releases nothing; a release is a tag.
